subject: Post-call exec recap: pilot & procurement path (Silverline Tech)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@silverlinetech.com>, Rajiv Sharma <rajiv@silverlinetech.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.inference>, lauren.bishop@redwood.inference
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps (Silverline Tech)

Hi Elena / Rajiv

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our exec/discovery call and proposed next steps so everyone is aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Spiky latency at the 95th percentile during peak batch processing windows (current 95p ~800-1,200ms) causing downstream user complaints.
- High per-token inference costs for both real-time chat and nightly bulk summarization jobs.
- Need for predictable throughput and stronger isolation for customer data (regulatory reasons in two EU markets).
- Model versioning + rollback needs across multi-region deployments.

Desired business outcomes:
- Reduce inference unit cost by ~30-40% on bulk workloads and 20-30% on real-time requests.
- Achieve 95p latency <200ms for interactive workflows.
- Private deployment option or VPC peering with KMS integration for EU-resident data.

Risks & blockers called out:
- Procurement timeline / PO approval window (legal + security review).
- Need for SOC2 evidence and clarifications on data retention + audit logs.
- On-prem network constraints for a potential private deployment.

Proposed path forward:
1) Pilot (3-4 weeks): Redwood Dedicated reserved pool for a scoped set of endpoints (chat + summarization), measurable SLOs (95p latency, cost baseline), and integration with your KMS for key management.
2) Security review: we will share our SOC2 package and a short security questionnaire answers (attached).
3) Commercials & SOW: attached preliminary SOW + pricing deck for pilot and typical production options; we can iterate once you confirm scope.
4) Procurement: target PO within 6-8 weeks post-pilot; happy to support with a short exec summary for your procurement/legal.

Immediate next steps I propose:
- I will send the SOW & pricing deck (attached) and HubSpot deal link.
- Dylan (cc'd) to run a 60-minute technical deep-dive next week to validate integration points (KMS, VPC, model routing).
- Can we aim for a pilot kickoff week of Mar 23? Please share any hard constraints.

Attachments: Silverline_Tech_POC_SOW_v1.pdf, Redwood_Pricing_Deck_2026.pdf, SOC2_compliance_package.zip

Open items you asked us to follow up on:
- Ballpark pricing for a 3-node Dedicated pilot (Dylan will provide).
- SOC2 artifacts and data retention policy (attached).
- Example runbook for failover and model rollback (Dylan will include in the technical follow-up).

Thanks - looking forward to the next steps. If useful, I can draft a one-page exec summary for your procurement team.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0132

Marissa - thanks for the clear recap. A couple additions from our side:

1) Procurement constraints: our P&L owner needs a 2-3 week internal review before PO approval; if we can provide an executive one-pager and a draft SOW for legal, that will speed things.
2) Security: we need confirmation that Redwood can integrate with our Azure Key Vault / HSM. Also need to see evidence of continuous audit logs and per-request metadata retention policy.
3) Technical risk: our ops team flagged questions around cold-start behavior for large models during nightly bulk jobs.

Could you provide a ballpark monthly price for the 3-node pilot (we're looking to budget roughly $40-60k/month depending on throughput)? If you can confirm whether that expectation is in-range that helps us decide the pilot scale.

I'll loop in procurement once we have the SOW draft. Thanks - Rajiv
